rationale: The workflow repeatedly fetches Go module dependencies in both the setup and validate-example jobs (setup-go with go-version-file go.mod, then make modtidy check-diff and example builds). The repository ships go.mod/go.sum lockfiles, satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE precondition that cache inputs include the lockfile and environment. Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on runner OS and hashFiles('go.mod','go.sum') reuses downloaded modules across runs without altering any check: go mod tidy check-diff still runs and still fails on drift, and every example validation still executes. Measured P-LIT-GHA-CACHE evidence shows reduced elapsed time with unchanged success. The change is minimal, adds no secrets, deployment/publishing, privileged action, or new external network beyond the standard Actions cache service, and preserves required coverage.
